original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: List the existing independent checks for the exact selected or candidate sources. Pick a new changed input, missing binding or distinct failure mode; stop with a handoff if the proposed arithmetic check is already covered.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Independent source-bound verification of open PR2530 (zxv, head b4012098; T74 source-partner lifetimes, conditional kappa ~0.0017137379), the base of the open T74 claim line. With code independent of PR2530, it checks the implications that no concurrent independent audit checks: both changed words end to end (forward and dual, through cleanup and target endpoint), physical stock, the endpoint enclosure and the outer kappa composition, the verifier overrides and the R-g owner charts. It corroborates the overlapping audits PR2664 (handoffs, gate climbs), PR2656 (profile recount), PR2661 (windows, fill R-a..R-e, idle) and PR2669 (windows) with a third implementation, and records the fill's order dependence. PR code is read as data only.
scope_change_reason: Assignment seed 63 (adversarial-audit track of the sprint prompt). PR2530 is a changed supplier claim (new words, order, fill and endpoint) with no PR review or maintainer disposition. The card's generic question is narrowed to PR2530's finitely checkable implications. Before packaging, the existing independent checks were read at their heads (PR2664, PR2656, PR2661, PR2669, rcfc-jreed on #2621). The package names that coverage as corroboration and adds the rest.
bottleneck_link: The open T74 claim line (#2571, #2575, #2588, #2621, #2673, #2679, #2696, #2733, #2745, #2751, #2766, #2767, #2802) builds on PR2530's words and diagonal order. PR2530's words carry to #2571 and #2575, and its order to #2575, #2588 and #2679 (checked at heads on 2026-10-15 20:56 UTC). An independent check, or a counterexample, decides what those claims can inherit. The selected frontier is unchanged (kappa 0.001672660197076918, #1094), and PR2530 is undispositioned on main.
stop_rule: Stop after independently checking every implication of PR2530 listed in the README (words end to end, profile, order and windows, fill, stock, endpoint, kappa composition, overrides) with semantic negative controls that each name the rule that must reject them. Report unexecuted native, global and outer stages as gaps. No construction, search or optimisation.
evidence: verify.py, standard library only, PR code never run. Both words are exact on 646 dirty inputs, forward and dual, through cleanup (4,529 items, equal to our inverse-reverse) and target endpoint. The 8 new lenders hold X_r at handoff, and the 9 inserted gates add zero climbs. Profile {1:2369,2:632,3:320,4:118,5:26,7:8}; 8 centres [7,1]. The diagonal order and 1332 windows match. The fill of 281,052 roles satisfies R-a..R-e in two implementations plus R-g (7023 charts); idle and global profile equal the claim; 238 of 665 adjacent cross-replica swaps keep it legal. Physical stock 66814 (a consistency check). The endpoint C is accepted and C+1e-24 rejected; kappa = C - 1e-70 - 1e-46 given the author-checked outer inequalities. The overrides change only the two pins (target offsets, centre children) and add the zero-buffer term to the physical-stock formula; no check is weakened. 148/148 rejections (99 distinct controls, including a dual-only mutant that the forward replay accepts), each by its named rule; 3 positive controls; all 62 checker mutations killed (local-only). No defect found.

open_questions.question: Is the native K_op the same operator, including Clifford phases and monomial lift, for the 12 lenders whose K_op is applied in both the A prelude and the B handoff (49, 83, 98, 101, 68, 80, 88, 31, 33, 55, 74, 85)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: #2571 and #2575 use exactly these words, and later claims reuse the same prelude/handoff warp mechanism with changed assignments. The identity is author-checked only, by PR2530's native 512-column receipts; the free-operator replay treats each warp as one abstract letter.
open_questions.first_step: Re-implement the 512-column monomial check for these 12 operators from the pinned native receipts' inputs and compare with the receipts.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing; this needs only a careful independent reading of the native operator encoding.

open_questions.first_step: Restate the inherited ledger formulas and recompute the strict rows from PR2530's SPEC with an own implementation.
open_questions.blocked_by: The inherited outer-ledger formulas must be restated from the PR2462 lineage; no new data is needed.

open_questions.question: Does PR2530's strict global admission (async emission, pooled-slot binding, finite invoice, native lowering) re-execute on a second platform under the diagonal order with PR2530's own fill?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This matters only if PR2530 itself is considered for admission: later claims use their own fills, and #2571 also shifts the order. PR2530's own admission run is author-checked.

family_expansion_decision: None proposed. This audit recommends no further fill, order or word optimisation on the T74 line; its open questions only close named obligations of PR2530's own claim.
